outcome: Association between microbial colonization and non-communicable diseases
Impact of host and environmental factors on early microbial colonization
cohort: Mother-infant pairs in the Spanish-Mediterranean area
finding: The MAMI study aims to characterize maternal microbial transfer to neonates and identify host/environmental factors influencing early-life microbial colonization.
mod_finding: The study will investigate mode of delivery as a potential factor affecting early microbial colonization.
